showCounts.name: Show troop totals on the board
showCounts.hint: Draw a numbered disc in the controlling faction's colour on every occupied territory.

showTooltip.name: Territory hover info
showTooltip.hint: Hovering a territory shows its owner, troops, city, scar and fortification.

autoArrange.name: Tidy pieces after moves
autoArrange.hint: After a piece is dragged into another territory, arrange the pieces of both territories onto their placement spots.

Keys.cancelHint: Cancels picking a territory or placing troops on the world board.

Controls.arrange: Tidy all pieces onto their spots
Controls.setTroopsPrompt: Pick a territory to set troops in
Controls.rebuild: Rebuild the board scene and territory regions (GM)
Controls.rebuildConfirm: Rebuild the world board scene from the board definition? Territory regions are reset to the traced shapes; pieces stay where they are.
Controls.clear: Remove all pieces from the board (GM)
Controls.clearConfirm: Remove every troop and HQ piece from the world board?

Banner.pickHint: Click a highlighted territory. Esc or right-click to cancel.
Banner.placeHint: Click a territory: choose how many troops · Shift-click: place 1 · Esc or right-click to stop.

place.join: Join the War: choose a starting territory

Banner.point: Choose a spot on the board
Banner.pointHint: Move the sticker to a free spot and click to place it. Esc or right-click to cancel.

War.attackPick: Attack: pick one of your territories
War.expandPick: Expand: pick one of your territories
War.pickHint: Click one of your highlighted territories, or drag from it straight onto a target.
War.attackHint: Click or drag onto a red territory to attack with the most dice (Shift-click: choose the dice). Click another of your territories to attack from there.
War.expandHint: Click or drag onto a yellow territory, then choose how many troops (Shift-click: all but one). Click another of your territories to expand from there.
War.moveInHint: Click the blue {to} to move more troops in (Shift-click: all but one).
War.stopHint: Right-click to deselect, Esc to stop.
War.attackNone: None of your territories can attack
War.expandNone: None of your territories can expand
War.noneHint: Switch mode, or press Esc and go on to the next step.
War.pickFirst: Pick one of your highlighted territories first.
War.battleOpenHint: Roll and resolve it in chat. Attack mode stays on: once the battle is over, click again to keep attacking. Esc to stop.
War.troopsCost: Troops to move ({cost} will be lost on arrival)
War.stepOver: the expand & attack step is over.

Reason.outside: Pieces must stay inside a territory.
Reason.oneGroup: Move troops from one territory into one other territory at a time.

Notify.noBattle: Battles aren't available yet: the move was cancelled.
Notify.rebuilt: The world board scene was rebuilt.

Error.noScene: There is no world board scene. A GM can build it from the Risk Legacy scene controls.
Error.gmOnly: Only the GM (or the turn controller) can do that.
Error.needThree: Three 1-troop pieces are needed in the same territory.

Water.offBoard: Too close to the edge of the board.
Water.seaLine: Covers the sea line between {a} and {b}.
